description: Source code for generating and manipulating on-disk JFFS2 filesystem structures for MTD devices, including functions for creating directories, files, and parsing JFFS2 data.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads the buffer to align with the specified size, erasing blocks as necessary.

methods.name: add_dirent
methods.description: Adds a directory entry with specified name, type, and parent inode.

methods.name: add_dir
methods.description: Creates a directory inode and associated directory entry.

methods.name: add_file
methods.description: Adds a file to the filesystem structure, reading file contents and creating corresponding inodes.

methods.name: mtd_replace_jffs2
methods.description: Replaces part of an MTD device with a JFFS2 filesystem image.

methods.name: mtd_parse_jffs2data
methods.description: Parses JFFS2 data buffer to update internal inode and version counters.

methods.name: mtd_write_jffs2
methods.description: Writes a file into a JFFS2 filesystem on an MTD device, creating necessary directory structures.
